faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before subscribing.
faq.q1: Can I change my plan anytime?
faq.a1: Yes—you can upgrade or cancel your subscription anytime from your dashboard. Changes take effect immediately.
faq.q2: Is there a minimum commitment period?
faq.a2: No. All plans are month-to-month with no lock-in. Annual billing saves you 20% compared to monthly. You can cancel anytime from your dashboard.
faq.q3: Is the Free plan truly free?
faq.a3: Yes—no credit card required, no time limit. The Free plan allows you to explore PISUM with 10 templates, 50 reports per month, and PDF export. Upgrade whenever you're ready.
faq.a4: AI Dictation converts your voice in real-time into structured radiology report text. It operates via a secure API—audio data is never stored. Your monthly quota resets on the first day of each month.
faq.a5: All payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy, a PCI-compliant payment platform. PISUM never stores your banking details.
faq.q6: Where is my data stored? Is PISUM GDPR compliant?
faq.a6: Your patient reports are stored on your local computer—PISUM never uploads clinical data to the cloud. Account data (name, email, subscription status) is hosted on Supabase's EU servers. PISUM is fully GDPR compliant.
faq.q7: Does PISUM require an internet connection?
faq.a7: Yes. PISUM requires an active internet connection for AI Dictation, AI Enhancer, and subscription management. While your patient reports and templates are stored locally on your computer, AI features securely connect to our cloud APIs.
faq.q8: Are there free trials for paid plans?
faq.a8: The Free plan is a permanent free tier—no time limit, no credit card. Starter, Pro, and Expert plans all include a 14-day free trial, allowing you to experience full features risk-free before being charged. All paid plans also come with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

index.ai_pillar1_desc: 将随意的听写或电报式笔记提升到学术级的放射学文本 — 与 Radiology 或 European Radiology 的出版物无法区分。格式和术语都得到保留。
index.ai_pillar2_desc: 交叉对照所有发现，命名统一的综合征 — 不是组件列表，而是诊断本身。Budd-Chiari。Conn 综合征。转移性模式。您本来就会写出的结论，只需几秒钟。
index.ai_pillar3_desc: 血管血栓形成、活动性出血、张力性发现、器官缺血 — 危及生命的发现始终作为第一个结论条目出现，并清楚标记紧急程度。绝不隐藏在样板文字中。
index.ai_cta: 解锁 AI 增强与诊断
index.ai_cta_sub: Pro+ 套餐 · 支持所有 23 种语言
index.feat_ai_desc: 以普通语言口述或键入发现。PISUM 将其改写为学术级放射学词汇，交叉比对所有体征以命名统一综合征，校准诊断确定性，并首先标记危及生命的发现——就像一位高级放射科医生审阅每一份报告一样。
index.feat_ai_critical: 🔴 危急 — 立即临床关联
